content: An'lɔɔŋ a Ywan Un'düümà
Nsɛmà a Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là Yɛsu Klistɔ, Mwan a Nzam:
Uboo a un'kaan a ŋangɔɔm Yɛsay bàsön naa:

content.text: « Le, mɛ an'tɔm un'kyeey amɛ kusà a ngye
Ndaa mwɛy yàmusà in'kwɛŋ u nsye a ipɔl:

content: Apan Ywan Un'düümà kàkàmɛnà u nsye a ipɔl, muyilɔŋ baar mubuul mpem anà muwal ndüümà, ntɔn badwääl nkul a man'be.
-Itiir a Yuday kyanswà anà baar a Yɛlusàlɛm banswà bàkyeenà akà nde, bàkyeyà man'be aba, waa nde kàfadümà u Yɔrdan.
Ywan kàkäl aŋàbwaar ipfɛy a in'kà a ntsür bàfàbel naa shamo anà un'kab a iban a ntsür kyàŋàkwam u lɔŋ ande. Nde kàdyee mpay anà bwey a nsye.
Nde kàkyäänà naa: « Mbuur kàman'söön u ngwal wàmuyà ungö a mɛ. Mɛ in'kwo anki munye ntɔn mutsuuŋ in'siŋ a idyaar ande.
Mɛ, mɛ kàladümà kan'dà, wɛɛ nde, nde ayàladümà u Dweelà Inkyɛɛl. »
Ndüümà anà ndɛb a Yɛsu
Yàmɛnà naa kà ilä abin Yɛsu kàfü Nasàlɛr u Ngalilɛ. Ywan kun'dümà u Yɔrdan.
Pa kàtoo nde kan'dà, nde kàmɛn du làmudubà. Dweelà kàyàtyà udu a nde asànaa nkokà.
Ndaa yàfü du, yàtɛn naa: « Ngye awà Mwan amɛ wà nkween. Mpem amɛ yanswà ye amu ngye. »
Kà imbürà, Dweelà kun'siinà u nsye a ipɔl.
Kwo, Satanà kun'lwɛb ilä an'kwem an'nà. Nde kàkälà anà ntsür a ndwaŋ, akyeey bun'syäälà.
Isal a Yɛsu u Ngalilɛ
Ungö bàyälà ba Ywan, Yɛsu kàkyen Ngalilɛ. Kwo nde kàkyäänà Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là Nzam anà mutɛn naa:
« Taaŋ lan'kwo, Imwol a Nzam kyan'tol tsütsü. Làbuul mpem abɛ! Làsi làkwikilà amu Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ! »
Umpal kàkäl nde mulyäŋ kà un'kɔɔl a ɛwà a Ngalilɛ, nde kàmɛn Simɔn anà Andrɛ, un'tɔŋ a Simɔn, bàmutɔɔm an'kwen aba kà ɛwà: ba bàkäl alɔ̈ɔ̈b a nsö.
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: « Yàlan'läb, waa mɛ in'yàlabuul alɔ̈ɔ̈b a baar. »
Apan sye, ba bàsàwɛy an'kwen aba, waa bun'läb.
Kàsin nde ikye, nde kàmɛn Zyak mwan a Zebeday anà un'tɔŋ ande Ywan. Ba bàkäl uboo a bwaar aba mulɔn an'kwen.
Apan sye, nde waa kabel. Ba bàsàwɛy taaràba Zebeday uboo a bwaar anà baar a isal, waa bun'läb.
Baal kàkäl anà dweelà a làbe
Yɛsu anà alɔŋki ande ban'bilà u Kapɛrnawum. Apan sye, ilä a saba, nde kàbilà u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà, waa kàlɔɔŋà.
Baar bàkäl mubem an'lɔɔŋ ande, ntɔn nde kàlɔɔŋà asànaa mbuur awe anà ikɔ̈b, wɛɛ kà asànaa alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn anki.
Kyekà uboo a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà akun, mbuur mwey kàkäl anà dweelà a làbe, nde kàsi in'kwɛŋ:
« Yɛsu, un'nsi Nasàlɛr, ininà ngye akwen akà bi? Nkye ngye ayi ntɔn muböŋ bi? Mɛ in'kyàyöb naa ngye awà nà: ngye awà Ŋun'kyeel a Nzam! »
Yɛsu kun'swɛŋ a ngwal naa: « Kal a duu! Too uboo a mbuur wà! »
Dweelà a làbe waa làtoo, lun'nini, làmuyisà un'kwɛŋ a kölàköl.
Baar banswà bàkäl mubem, waa bàsyeelà mbaaŋ ba a ba naa: « Ndaa nà ayi? An'lɔɔŋ akün màŋàyɔl a ikɔ̈b! Nde wàmuswaŋ an'dweelà an'be a ngwal, ma sye màmukun'wem! »
Làsaŋ a nde làpää agyägyä kà itiir a nsi a Ngalilɛ kyanswà.
Yɛsu kan'kɔɔr abɛy mbɔɔn
Pa bàtoo ba u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà, ba bàkyen anà Zyak anà Ywan u ndwà a Simɔn anà Andrɛ.
Kyekà ukwà a Simɔn wun'kaar kàkäl aŋàbɔ̈ɔ̈n ntɔn nde kàkäl anà làbwey a mpye. Apan sye, ba bàsam Yɛsu ntɔn nde.
Nde kàsin tsütsü, kun'käär u kɔɔ, waa kun'mbaar. Làbwey a mpye waa làtoo, nde waa kàsɛmà mukasyääl.
Làsisye, ungö a miinà a taaŋ, ba bun'twäälà baar an'kyal banswà anà baar bàkäl anà an'dweelà an'be.
Bul lanswà làyàköŋ u munàmbwo.
Yɛsu kàkɔɔr baar mbɔɔn bàkäl anà an'kyal a ifà ifà. Nde kàtwey sye insɔŋà mbɔɔn. Nde kàwɛy anki mbwo akà insɔŋà musà ndaa. Ntɔn mya, mya myàkyun'yöbà.
Yɛsu kan'lyaaŋ u Ngalilɛ
Ututu tutu, Yɛsu kàsubà nde, kàtoo u ndwà, waa kàkyen u mpey. Akun nde kàkäl muyamà.
Simɔn anà baar bamwey bàkäl anà nde bàkyer akun'leŋ.
Utaaŋ bun'mɛn ba, ba bàtɛn a nde naa: « Baar banswà bàmuyaleŋ. »
Yɛsu kafuur naa: « Tsweenà ikal asin, kan'bul a tsütsü, ntɔn mɛ in'kàkyään sye Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ kwo. Mɛ, mɛ kàtoo ntɔn la. »
Nde waa kàyilyaaŋà u Ngalilɛ wanswà mulɔŋ uboo a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà anà muböŋ insɔŋà.
Yɛsu kan'pööŋ ŋukyal a bay
Yàmɛnà naa ŋukyal a bay mwɛy kàsin apà nde, kàbü an'köm, waa kàtɛn naa: « Kya ngye akyàkwen, ngye an'kwo an'pöŋ. »
Yɛsu kun'wɛm ngyɛb mbɔɔn, kàsɛn kɔɔ, kun'bä, waa kàtɛn naa: « Mɛ an'kwen, pɔŋà! »
Umbalà mwɛy bay waa làlwomà, nde waa kàpɔŋà.
Apan, Yɛsu kun'fuur ndwà ande,
ungö mukun'pà nswɛɛŋ yi: « Twon an'sam ndaa ayi akà mbuur mwɛy. Wɛɛ ngye, kyɛn kamɛnà akà ngaŋ, waa akàpà an'kab a mpööŋ asànaa kàlɔ̈m Mɔsɛ, ntɔn mukaswaŋ naa ngye an'kɔrà. »

Pa kàkyen nde, nde kàsɛmà mukyään u ndaa a ngwal anà mupay làsaŋ a ndaa ayi. Kyakin Yɛsu kàmɛn anki mbwo mukàmɛnà u mii a baar banswà kan'bul an'köl an'köl, wɛɛ nde kàkälà u nsà, u mpey. Waa baar bàfwee mper anà mper, bàyee akà nde.
